description_fill_in: Unique identifier for each agent task (T001–T100). Groups multiple execution steps that belong to the same user request.
Global sequential step counter (1–500) across all tasks. Indicates the chronological order in which steps were recorded across the entire dataset.
Name of the tool invoked in this step. One of: web_search, code_exec, calc, api_call, file_read, email_draft.
Binary flag indicating whether the tool execution succeeded (1) or failed (0).
Number of LLM tokens consumed during this step (includes prompt and completion tokens). Range: 109–3999.
Wall-clock execution time for this step in seconds. Range: 0.18–29.89.
Number of retry attempts made before recording this step's outcome. Values: 0 (no retry), 1, or 2.
